title: Sparkly cheese wedge
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="cheeseTop" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffe066"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffcc33"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="cheeseFront" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffb700"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#f29000"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- shadow glow around wedge -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="38" ry="7" fill="#5a3b00" opacity="0.45"/>
  <!-- wedge front face -->
  <path d="M14 62 L58 78 L58 84 L14 68 Z" fill="#f29000"/>
  <!-- wedge side face -->
  <path d="M58 78 L86 60 L86 66 L58 84 Z" fill="#ffb700"/>
  <!-- wedge top face -->
  <path d="M14 62 L42 44 L86 60 L58 78 Z" fill="url(#cheeseTop)"/>
  <!-- lighter top edge highlight -->
  <path d="M14 62 L42 44 L86 60" fill="none" stroke="#fff3b0" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <!-- front/side edge highlight -->
  <path d="M58 78 L86 60" fill="none" stroke="#ffd966" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- holes on top face -->
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="60" rx="5.5" ry="3.4" fill="#e08a00"/>
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="60" rx="5.5" ry="3.4" fill="none" stroke="#ffdf80" stroke-width="1.3"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="63" rx="4" ry="2.6" fill="#e08a00"/>
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="61" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#e08a00"/>
  <!-- hole on side face -->
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="71" rx="3.6" ry="2.6" fill="#d98200"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="71" rx="3.6" ry="2.6" fill="none" stroke="#ffd966" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <!-- hole on front face -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="71" rx="3.6" ry="2.6" fill="#d98200"/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill="#fff7c2">
    <path d="M20 22 L22.5 30 L30.5 32.5 L22.5 35 L20 43 L17.5 35 L9.5 32.5 L17.5 30 Z"/>
    <path d="M78 18 L79.8 24 L85.8 25.8 L79.8 27.6 L78 33.6 L76.2 27.6 L70.2 25.8 L76.2 24 Z" fill="#ffe066"/>
    <path d="M88 42 L89.3 46.5 L93.8 47.8 L89.3 49.1 L88 53.6 L86.7 49.1 L82.2 47.8 L86.7 46.5 Z" fill="#fff7c2"/>
    <path d="M8 48 L9.2 52 L13.2 53.2 L9.2 54.4 L8 58.4 L6.8 54.4 L2.8 53.2 L6.8 52 Z" fill="#ffe066"/>
  </g>
</svg>
